description: Why: string-contains dispatch on error messages will silently misroute errors if message text changes, producing wrong NNTP response codes in production. What: peering/ingestion.rs classifies IngestResult variants by matching error strings containing ERR_MISSING_MESSAGE_ID and ERR_SIGNATURE_SELF_CHECK_FAILED. These constants are defined in one module and matched by string search in another. If the message text is refactored without updating the match strings, the classification silently falls through to the wrong branch. Use typed error variants instead.
title: Cross-module error classification via string-contains is fragile
